Ava: Quick Q — I got an email from BrightPath saying my 401(k) enrollment window closed on 3/1, but I submitted elections on 3/2 bc payroll cutover. Will my deferral still be applied retro to 3/1? Also trying to transfer old HSA from HealthFirst — vendor says we need 'plan sponsor approval' for rollovers after enrollment window. Anyone seen this exception?
Ben (Payroll): Hey @Ava — payroll processes deductions on the pay period they were entered; if election posted after cutoff it usually starts next pay. Retro adjustments are possible but require a payroll ticket. We need pay period dates, employee ID.
Lina (People Ops): Hey all — policy: enrollment changes are allowed within 30 days of hire, otherwise during open enrollment or qualifying life events. Retro 401k corrections are manual and not guaranteed. @Ben can you confirm steps?
Ben (Payroll): Steps: 1) Confirm election effective date 2) PR ticket with employee SSN last4 + earnings to reapply deduction 3) Coordinate with BrightPath to adjust deferral records. If classed as 'voluntary retro', benefits team signs off. Example command: ```create-payroll-ticket --emp 12345 --type retro-401k --period 2026-03-01```
Ava: Thanks. Pay period was 3/4 (biweekly). EmpID 78942. Do I need to submit docs for the HSA transfer too?
Samir (Benefits Admin): For HSA transfer, HealthFirst requires a signed transfer form from the plan sponsor. We can sign as plan admin only after confirming enrollment status. If enrollment missed, we can still accept the transfer but contributions won't start until effective date. @Ava send me the HSA acct # and transfer form.
BenefitsBot: Automated reminder — Open enrollment exceptions require case ticket within 10 business days. Link: https://intranet.redwood/bene-exceptions
Lina (People Ops): @Ava — I'll open an exceptions case on your behalf. Please DM the HSA transfer PDF and your bank info. Heads up: retro 401k corrections may show as employer-side adjustments on your April paystub.
Ava: sending DM now. Appreciate the help :pray:
Ben (Payroll): Ticket #PAY-2026-00421 created. Assigned: Ben. ETA: 7 business days for adjustment and payroll confirmation. I'll loop BrightPath after we get signed form.
Samir (Benefits Admin): Received HSA form in DM, thanks. I'll prepare the sponsor signature and ping BrightPath. Expect an email confirmation once the transfer initiates (usually 5–10 business days).
Lina (People Ops): Summarizing: 1) Payroll will attempt retro via ticket 2) Benefits will sign HSA transfer form 3) BrightPath/HealthFirst will handle the external transfer. @Ava we'll keep you posted.
Ava: perfect — thank you everyone! :smile:
